title: Regional Winners of Boeing BUILD 5.0 at IIT Gandhinagar
desc: Team INSTROLE from Oreejoy MedTech Private Limited poses alongside panel experts, mentors, and organizer representatives after winning the Boeing BUILD 5.0 Regional Round at the IIT Gandhinagar Innovation & Entrepreneurship Centre (IIEC).
